title: Quantum permutations and the Standard Model algebra
description:
The finite part of the Standard Model, in the Chamseddine–Connes approach, has algebra AF = ℂ ⊕ ℍ ⊕ M3(ℂ), and its quantum isometry groups were computed by Bhowmick, D'Andrea and Dabrowski. We explain how the quantum automorphism group of the complex algebra BF = ℂ ⊕ ℂ ⊕ M2(ℂ) ⊕ M3(ℂ) generated by AF, with its canonical trace, is a cocycle twist of the quantum permutation group S15+, and how the color parts of the quantum isometry groups are twists of S9+, and of a quantum group G3 ⊂ S9+ preserving an oriented area tensor on F32. We prove that G3 is infinite, with classical version of order 216, while the quantum symmetry group of the unoriented area tensor is classical, of order 432. With the trace coming from the fermions, the coaction preserves the weak and color summands separately, and the quantum automorphism group becomes a twist of S4+ *̂ S9+. We also discuss matrix models and maximality, the fermions and the Heisenberg group of order 27, the untwisting of color, which leads to color Lie algebras in the sense of Rittenberg, Wyler and Scheunert, the spectral action, and the mixing matrices.

The Python programs used in the paper are included, with their outputs.
